extracted.intended_audience: public relations and investor relations professionals; companies and organizations seeking press release distribution
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Business Wire's press-release distribution services, features, and capabilities — covering full-text distribution, regulatory filing support, targeted delivery, multimedia/photo distribution, measurement, and optimization resources. Intended to inform organizations how to prepare and distribute releases and what services/features impact reach and effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-text news release distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire transmits 'full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content to journalists, financial professionals, investor services, regulatory authorities and the general public worldwide.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire claims 'the most comprehensive news and disclosure network' and that they 'originate hundreds of thousands of news announcements each year,' implying that press releases should be prepared as full-text items for broad, multi-audience distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worldwide disclosure and regulatory filing support (EDGAR, SEDAR, UK, European disclosures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire 'offers services for satisfying regulatory obligations in the US and around the globe' and operates 'an in-house EDGAR team - an industry first - makes Business Wire the largest EDGAR filer in the newswire sector.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Canadian SEDAR and UK Regulatory filings and 'disclosure fulfillment in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Sweden and Switzerland.' Implies press releases/filings must meet jurisdictional disclosure requirements and that vendor support can be used to ensure compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pinpoint news delivery / industry targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: In the US Business Wire networks 'offer more than 200 industry segments to provide highly targeted news delivery to relevant audiences' (Business Wire, AutomotiveWire, EntertainmentWire, HealthWire, SportsWire).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of industry-segmented distribution is recommended for reaching relevant audiences; the company also provides issue-specific circuits (CSR Circuit, Public Policy Circuits) to target topic-focused audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographic and issue-specific targeting (LatinoWire & Ethnic Media, CSR Circuit, Public Policy Circuits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire provides demographic markets including 'Hispanic, African and Asian American' and issue-specific circuits such as CSR Circuit and Public Policy Circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases intended for particular demographic groups or policy/CSR topics should use these dedicated circuits to improve relevance and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-text carriage with major global news organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire is 'the only commercial newswire that has full-text carriage provisions with all of the world's leading news organizations: Agence France-Presse, Associated Press, Bloomberg, Dow Jones and ThomsonReuters.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribution via a wire with these carriage agreements increases the likelihood of pickup by major outlets; press releases should be formatted and timed to take advantage of this carriage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smart News Release platform (multimedia integration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Via Business Wire's 'exclusive Smart News Release platform, text news releases and multimedia content are posted online and distributed to key audiences via the Business Wire network.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Smart News Release format to combine text with multimedia for online posting and distribution; this format is presented as Business Wire's recommended way to enhance online visibility and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo Smart News Release / photo and multimedia distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Photo Smart News Releases 'are posted directly to Yahoo! Finance, distributed to daily newspapers in the US via the Associated Press photo network and posted to community and industry-based websites.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Photo distribution is emphasized (including UK/Europe/Asia via photo agency partnerships), so including high-quality photos and multimedia in a release is recommended to increase pickup and placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement and insight (NewsTrak analytics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire's 'suite of measurement and monitoring services, NewsTrak, provides news release distribution statistics, website posting reports, online viewership data, media clips, media intelligence, reputation management and analytics.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishers/PR teams should use distribution statistics and analytics to evaluate release performance and inform future optimization and targeting decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tradeshow & conference partnerships / Official Wire status
rubrics_metrics.description: The tradeshow and conference division provides 'integrated communications tools' and, by 'having Official Wire status at dozens' of events, 'provides unique additional exposure for our members' news.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Releases tied to trade shows or conferences can leverage Official Wire status to gain extra exposure; integrate press releases with event partnerships when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalized customer service, local newsrooms, fast turnaround and accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire maintains 'more newsrooms than any other commercial newswire' and provides 'better local support with fast turnaround of your news releases and greater accuracy.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timeliness, local customization, and accuracy are framed as important service differentiators — press releases should be prepared to take advantage of local newsroom support and quick distribution windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release optimization and SEO services (EON: Enhanced Online News)
rubrics_metrics.description: Features and services listed include 'How To Optimize a Press Release for Search', 'Press Release Optimization', 'SEO Services', and 'EON: Enhanced Online News.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optimizing press releases for search and online discoverability is recommended; use the vendor's SEO-focused services and EON enhancements to improve visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support resources and best-practice guidance (How to Write a Press Release, Sample Press Release, Webinars & Podcasts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire provides guidance resources such as 'How to Write a Press Release', 'Sample Press Release', 'Webinars & Podcasts', and 'Features News Tips.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The availability of templates, tips and educational content suggests following best-practice formats and advice (e.g., sample structure, multimedia usage, timing, regulatory considerations) when preparing releases.
